Ava (CS): Heads-up: prepping QBR for AshenCorp next Wed. Saw a 3x spike in embeddings spend in the last 14 days after they flipped Search V2 to prod. Need a quick cost playbook + action items to present to the customer. Who can pull a spend breakdown + suggested throttles/embedding batching + enablement timeline? cc: @Marcus @Priya
Marcus (Finance): Looking now. Quick numbers: total spend $18.4k (past 14d) vs $6.1k prior. Embeddings account for ~72% of token cost. I can run a route-level breakdown and a few what-if scenarios. Early thought: cap embedding rate or move to an 8-bit quantized variant on Dedicated to save ~30-40%.
Priya (AE): Noted. They’re in renewal window next month — need something concise and prescriptive. Can we have a 1-slide "cost stabilizer" for QBR: 1) temporary soft cap + alerts, 2) enable batching + prefix cache, 3) recommended pricing/impact. I can ask the PM to pause non-prod calls if we suggest it.
Sofia (Support): Onboarding status: Search V2 was canary, flipped prod flag last week which aligns with the spike. Logs show `client_id=ashencorp prod=true embeddings/sec=1200` right after rollout. I’ll upload the raw log snippet to the drive. Recommend a per-route quota while we coordinate.
redwood-alert-bot: ALERT: AshenCorp token burn anomaly detected — 2026-03-18 09:12 UTC — https://console.redwood/alerts/ALR-7782 :warning:
Ava (CS): Thanks. Marcus — can you produce a short table with cost-savings options (throttling, quantize/variant, batching) and estimated % savings + RISK (latency / quality). Priya — will you confirm if AE can propose a temporary quota to the customer? Sofia — please add per-route quota playbook steps. I’ll compile the slide and send a draft by EOD tomorrow.
Marcus (Finance): On it. Initial rough estimates: throttling (soft cap) => 20-30% savings (low quality risk), quantized model variant => 30-40% savings (possible edge-case generation regressions), batching + cache => 15-25% (depends on sequence length distribution). I’ll produce a small table with baseline, option, est savings, and main tradeoffs.
Priya (AE): :thumbsup: I’ll coordinate with AshenCorp PM. Suggest proposing: pause non-prod, accept temporary soft cap on embeddings, and schedule a joint review. Also note: Dedicated capacity reduces unit cost but needs ~60-day lead time — probably not viable before renewal.
Sofia (Support): Added initial runbook steps here: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/ashencorp-quota. Example command for temporary cap: `apply_quota --client ashencorp --route /v1/embeddings --limit 600/s`. I’ve also opened a support ticket to track rollback steps if the customer reports regressions.
Ava (CS): Action items recap: Marcus — deliver savings table (EOD), Priya — confirm ask to customer (by EOD), Sofia — finalize runbook steps (done/linked). I’ll draft the single-slide QBR snippet and post for review by 16:00 PT tomorrow. Anyone else to add?
Priya (AE): Scheduling internal sync now, will ping AshenCorp after we align.
Marcus (Finance): Posted draft numbers to FinOps channel for review: https://redwood.internal/finops/threads/1199. Will update with final percents and small sensitivity table.
Ava (CS): :white_check_mark: Thanks team — will collate and prep QBR snippet. If we can keep the slide to 3 bullets + one what-if table it’ll be easiest for the customer to action in the meeting.
